title: Water Tank (Two Pointers)
hints: Brute force: try every pair of walls, O(n^2). The 200,000-wall test will time out.
Start with the two outermost walls - that is the widest tank. Now think: which wall should you move inward to have any chance of a bigger tank?
The water level is limited by the SHORTER wall. Moving the taller wall inward can only reduce the width and cannot raise the limit, so always move the shorter one.
Use long long for the area: min height * width can exceed what an int holds.
